summary: This bill requires cell-cultivated meat, poultry, and plant-based protein products to carry prominent labels stating they are 'cell-cultivated' or 'plant-based alternative protein product,' are not derived from live animals, and meet new USDA/FDA standards of identity, while shifting regulatory oversight of cell collection and culturing to the FDA and applying meat/poultry inspection rules to these products.
